description: This source file defines a static internal class 'Constants' within the Orleans.Runtime namespace. It contains constant string values, static readonly GrainType fields representing various system target types, a GrainId for silo direct connection, a default timeout, and a frozen dictionary mapping specific GrainTypes to their singleton system target names. Additionally, it provides methods to retrieve the name of a system target and to check if a GrainType is a singleton system target.

classes.name: Constants
classes.description: Contains various constants, grain type definitions, a grain ID, timeout setting, a frozen dictionary for singleton system target names, and utility methods related to system target types in Orleans.

methods.name: SystemTargetName
methods.description: Returns the name associated with a given GrainType; if not found, returns the GrainType's string representation.

methods.name: IsSingletonSystemTarget
methods.description: Checks if a given GrainType is categorized as a singleton system target.
